principle.zh-CN: 低饱和自然色、衬线标题和柔和圆角；按钮为胶囊形，明暗主题采用各自的语义配色。
principle.en: Muted natural colours, serif headings and soft corners; pill buttons and semantic colours for each theme.

zh-CN: 桌面商品三列，600px 以下两列；分类按钮过滤现有卡片。商品链接通过 product 参数打开对应详情，购物袋数量读取本地记录。 根据 product 参数显示商品，数量限定 1–99 的整数；加入本地购物袋并更新数量，保存失败时说明无法持久保存。 读取 localStorage 购物袋；减到零时移除商品，数量上限 99，按演示单价重算合计。结算只显示反馈，不创建订单、支付或物流。
交付这三个页面及共享导航、脚本、样式、翻译和本地插画；使用原生 HTML/CSS/JavaScript，不接入真实业务服务。
en: Use three product columns on desktop and two below 600px. Category buttons filter existing cards. Product links pass the product parameter to details; bag counts read local records. Select the product using the product parameter, accepting integer quantities from 1 to 99. Add to the local bag, update the count and report persistence failure. Read the bag from localStorage, removing items at zero and capping quantities at 99. Recompute totals from demo unit prices. Checkout only shows feedback and creates no order, payment or delivery.
Deliver these three pages, shared navigation, scripts, styles, translations and local artwork using native HTML/CSS/JavaScript without live business services.

notes: 商品、价格与商品插画均为演示。购物袋保存在浏览器中，结算不产生订单或支付。
